title: Ting power quality
description: Whisker Labs Ting sensors via two ting-exporters (active-active) and a VictoriaMetrics at each site. Both stores hold the same sensor data, notifications, inferred cuts and context marks; exporter health, storage and alerts are each store's own host.

list.name: markers
list.label: Markers
list.query: None : none, Outages : outages, Ting notifications : notifications, Power events : power_events, Sensor restarts : restarts, Data gaps : gaps, Exporter alerts : alerts, Context marks : context

panels.title: Stream
panels.description: 1 while voltage samples arrive within the stale limit (60 s). Offline = the sensor, its site's power or network, or the Ting cloud.

panels.title: Voltage now
panels.description: Latest RMS reading. ANSI C84.1 Range A 114-126 V: green inside, orange 110-114, red outside.

panels.title: Voltage in range
panels.description: Lowest and highest 0.25 s reading in the selected range (from the 1-minute rollups).

panels.title: THD now
panels.description: Total harmonic distortion of the voltage, latest (updates about every 30 s).

panels.title: Coverage in range
panels.description: Share of the expected 4 samples per second that arrived. Gaps are outages at the site, in its network or in the cloud. Ends 2 minutes ago: the newest minutes are not rolled up yet.

panels.title: Delivery delay
panels.description: Arrival minus the sensor's own timestamp, newest sample: ~0.55 s on the cloud's live path, 4-8 s buffered. Samples are stored at the sensor's time either way.

options.content: **Markers** (dropdown above, in each site's panels):   ■ outage: Ting reported it, or inferred (no data, then a sensor restart)  ·  ■ data gap  ·  ● power event: below 110 V  ·  ● other Ting notification (brownout, surge, ...)  ·  ● sensor restarted  ·  ● exporter alert  ·  ● context mark (e.g. power source changed)  ·  hover a band or dot for its name

panels.title: Voltage · site $site
panels.description: Min, average and max per plotted point from the 1-minute rollups, so a sag of one 0.25 s sample stays visible over a month. Dashed: 110 / 114 / 126 V. Bands: this site's markers (Markers dropdown).

targets.expr: (((label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_outage{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 2, "kind", "Outage (community, Ting)") or label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_outage{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1, "kind", "Outage (Ting)") or on (site) label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_cut{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1, "kind", "Outage (inferred: no data, then a restart)")) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "outages"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((min_over_time((max by (site) (ting_voltage_rolling_high_volts{site="$site"}) - min by (site) (ting_voltage_rolling_low_volts{site="$site"}))[$__interval:1m]) < 2.5) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "restarts"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((((max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_stream_gap{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1) or ((min by (site) (min_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval])) < 180) or ((($__interval_ms / 60000) - max by (site) (count_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval]))) >= 1) or (max by (site) (last_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[1d])) unless max by (site) (count_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval])))) and on () (vector(time()) < (${__to} / 1000 - 150)))) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "gaps"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((max by (site, alertname) (max_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Ting.*", site="$site"}[$__interval]))) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "alerts"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((count by (site, context, value) (count_over_time(ting_context{site="$site"}[$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "context"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

panels.title: Frequency · site $site
panels.description: Line frequency. Sites on different grids never move together. Bands: this site's markers.

targets.expr: (((label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_outage{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 2, "kind", "Outage (community, Ting)") or label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_outage{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1, "kind", "Outage (Ting)") or on (site) label_set(max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_power_cut{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1, "kind", "Outage (inferred: no data, then a restart)")) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "outages"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((min_over_time((max by (site) (ting_voltage_rolling_high_volts{site="$site"}) - min by (site) (ting_voltage_rolling_low_volts{site="$site"}))[$__interval:1m]) < 2.5) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "restarts"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((((max by (site) (max_over_time(ting_stream_gap{site="$site"}[$__interval])) == 1) or ((min by (site) (min_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval])) < 180) or ((($__interval_ms / 60000) - max by (site) (count_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval]))) >= 1) or (max by (site) (last_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[1d])) unless max by (site) (count_over_time(ting:voltage_volts:count_1m{site="$site"}[$__interval])))) and on () (vector(time()) < (${__to} / 1000 - 150)))) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "gaps"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((max by (site, alertname) (max_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Ting.*", site="$site"}[$__interval]))) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "alerts"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

(((count by (site, context, value) (count_over_time(ting_context{site="$site"}[$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 1) and on () label_match(label_set(vector(1), "marker", "context"), "marker", "${markers:regex}"))

panels.title: THD
panels.description: Voltage THD: average (solid) and the sensor's interval maximum (dashed), per site.

panels.title: Hi-Fi (peak)
panels.description: Ting's Hi-Fi value (AveragePeaksMax), highest per point. Whisker Labs documents no unit; compare a site with its own normal level.

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Share of expected samples per plotted point. A drop to 0 is an outage. Ends 2 minutes ago: the newest minutes are not rolled up yet.

panels.title: Delivery delay
panels.description: Live path ~0.55 s, buffered 4-8 s. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Hub sessions ended, by reason (stale = the sensor went silent). This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Push to VictoriaMetrics
panels.description: Samples per second by push target and outcome. Anything but ok for long means that target (the local VictoriaMetrics, or the peer over the tunnel) is not taking data. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Push lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest sample each store has not taken yet. A store that is unreachable (the peer over the tunnel) falls behind; the outbox keeps everything (256 MiB, about two weeks) and catches up. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: Alert at 90 GB of data and below 25 GB free; VictoriaMetrics stops writing below 10 GB free. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Sensor's own high/low
panels.description: VoltageHi/Lo as the sensor reports them: extremes over a long window of its own, not per sample. A jump shows the sensor restarted its window.

panels.title: Outbox and rollup repair
panels.description: Outbox size on disk, and the 1-minute rollups the exporter filled where vmalert missed them. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Health checks
panels.description: The exporter's own checks of VictoriaMetrics, vmalert, Alertmanager and the peer (1 = passes). A check that fails 5 minutes notifies Home Assistant directly. This data source's own exporter and VictoriaMetrics: each store scrapes only its own host.

panels.title: Raw voltage · site $site
panels.description: Every 0.25 s sample. For zooms of up to a day; longer ranges belong to the rollup panels above.

panels.title: Power source
panels.description: The power source marked with `ting-exporter mark <site> source=<name>`, in force until the next mark.

panels.title: THD by power source
panels.description: Average THD while each marked source was in force (legend: mean and max over the range).

targets.expr: 100 * avg by (site, value) (avg_over_time(ting:thd_ratio:avg_1m{site=~"$site"}[$__interval]) * on (site) group_left (value) (last_over_time(ting_context{context="source", site=~"$site"}[5y]) == 1))

panels.title: Hi-Fi by power source
panels.description: Highest Hi-Fi while each marked source was in force (legend: mean and max over the range).

targets.expr: max by (site, value) (max_over_time(ting:hifi:max_1m{site=~"$site"}[$__interval]) * on (site) group_left (value) (last_over_time(ting_context{context="source", site=~"$site"}[5y]) == 1))

panels.title: Outdoor temperature
panels.description: Outdoor temperature at the site, as Ting's conditions report it.

panels.title: Outage risk
panels.description: Ting's outage risk for the site, the number Ting sends (it looks like a percentage).

panels.title: Hazard state
panels.description: Ting's fire hazard state: 0 none, 1 learning, 2 reviewed not fire, 3 elevated suspicious, 4 power quality hazard, 5 fire hazard, -1 unknown.
